# Universal Physio Care
> Premium In-Home Physical Therapy & Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) Home Visits in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Core Clinical Offerings
- `Back & Neck Pain Therapy -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services`: Evidence-based manual therapy, spinal mobilization, and pain relief for sciatica, lumbar disc herniation, and cervical strain.
- `Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services`: Comprehensive treatment for joint dysfunctions, arthritis, tendonitis, and soft tissue injuries.
- `Stroke Rehabilitation -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services`: Specialized neuro-physiotherapy to rebuild motor control, coordination, gait, and daily living independence after a stroke.
- `Post-Surgical Rehabilitation -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services`: Dedicated recovery protocols for ACL reconstruction, total knee replacement (TKR), total hip replacement (THR), and fracture rehab.
- `Elderly Care & Fall Prevention -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services`: Balance training, strength preservation, and mobility assistance for senior citizens in home settings.

## Clinical Authority & Medical Accreditation
- All visiting physiotherapists hold accredited Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degrees.
- Registered with national medical and physical therapy councils.
- Over 1,500+ patient sessions completed across Lahore with a 98% patient satisfaction rate.
